# Explicit ecosystem identity adoption

createCentralBrowserSessionRegistry(productRegistry, {ecosystem:true}) is an explicit server/build configuration. Omission preserves the exact existing six-client default. The new complete thirteen-client profile adds only Calendar, Cloud, Docs, Mail, Shop, Video and Creator to Finance, Exchange, Quant, Social, AI and Developer. Each tuple comes from its exact product registration; each scope remains only identity:read and its audience is ynx:PRODUCT:identity. Web redirect is the same product origin /sso/callback. This does not grant mail, file, payment, publishing or other private scopes.

Old complete 3/5/6 profiles remain byte-equivalent. Their original signed consent is never enlarged. A live old six-client session can still authorize Finance but cannot silently authorize Mail; new sites require the newly listed complete profile and a fresh visible Wallet signature. Unknown subsets, substituted origins/scopes and incomplete registries remain rejected. New initiators cannot downgrade into an old roster that omits them.

This source does not enable the option in a running Gateway, generate backend keys or change protected config. Source-bound generated Wallet/Auth review bundles and compatible protected per-product backend registration must be admitted together before enabling the roster. Each backend client must use its own protected key and exact audience/tuple. Family refresh/activity/logout remains only finite identity permission; private service approval stays separate. Original local/browser logout lineage, absolute 2h/idle30m and durable family CAS are unchanged.

Tests run a real original CentralBrowserSessionAuthority and original protected store with one synthetic QA key. First test failure was a test schema error from incorrectly spreading PKCE authorize-only fields into redemption; the corrected test sends the unchanged exact redemption schema. The original failure log is retained. No production state, browser profile or user key is used.
